baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two coordinated produce nouns at focus words 1 and 2, rooted in ع ن ب and ق ض ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first noun supplies a ripened vine-fruit, while the second supplies green growth whose edible identity is tied to being cut and consumed fresh. The pair therefore spans two harvest regimes rather than merely adding two interchangeable foods: fruit allowed to mature on a lasting plant and herbage made useful by timely removal.

activation_trace.role: The vine-fruit image supplies a bounded, ripened edible yield supported by a continuing plant.
The fresh-cut green-fodder image supplies a yield defined by immediate cutting and use.

changed_reading.before: Two edible plants are appended to a produce list.
changed_reading.after: The verse pairs complementary cultivation outputs: a matured vine-fruit and a crop whose freshness and usefulness arrive through cutting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of the vine-fruit at word 1 and the cutting-derived plant noun at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: One focus root keeps fruit in relation to its vine; the other opens a network of severing, clipped ends, and usable boughs. Their coordination stages cultivation as a relation between sustained attachment and selective interruption: growth is preserved until a cut converts part of it into provision.

activation_trace.role: The fruit-of-the-vine image supplies organic attachment and maturation on a living support.
The cutting-off image supplies the decisive intervention that separates useful growth.
The rod and cut-bough image keeps the severance mechanism concretely within plant husbandry.

changed_reading.before: The two nouns identify botanical kinds.
changed_reading.after: The pair also encodes a choreography of attachment, branching, and a productive harvest cut.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch-distant swelling image under focus root ع ن ب at word 1 beside the explicit severance network of ق ض ب at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grape-like swelling branch presents matter gathered under a skin and capable of filling with fluid; the cutting branch presents matter opened and separated. Even before context, the pair can carry a material contrast between contained pressure and release by incision. This does not replace the crop reading, but it is a live physical undertone.

activation_trace.role: The fluid-filling swelling image supplies rounded containment and pressure beneath a surface.
The severing image supplies opening, separation, and release from a prior whole.

changed_reading.before: The pair is visually and materially neutral beyond naming crops.
changed_reading.after: A secondary material reading juxtaposes fluid fullness under a skin with matter opened and separated by a cut.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier repeated root ك ر م overtly carries honor and commendable generosity, but its inventory also contains plant excellence and the grapevine itself. When the focus vine-fruit appears, that dormant botanical branch re-enters the overt honor language. The grape can consequently function as a material instance of cultivated excellence and generous yield, without erasing the ordinary sense of either passage.

activation_trace.role: The fruit-of-the-vine image gives the focus noun a direct botanical contact with the latent vine branch of ك ر م.
The honor-and-generosity image supplies the overt evaluative register that may be materialized in the later crop.
The grape-and-vine image supplies the otherwise latent lexical bridge from earlier honor language to the focus fruit.

structural_cues: The root ك ر م recurs in 80:13 and 80:16 before the focus produce sequence.
The focus fruit occurs after the command to inspect food, allowing an earlier abstract value to return in a concrete cultivated form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated honor-language, a ك ر م vine branch, and a focus branch defining the fruit through its vine; I infer a cross-domain echo from honored generosity to cultivated yield. A live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no intended transfer between the passages.

changed_reading.before: The grape is one valued crop among others.
changed_reading.after: The grape may also be the botanical re-entry of earlier ك ر م, concretizing honor and generosity as excellent, yielding cultivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human sequence of loss of life, burial, and renewed animation is followed by an invitation to inspect food. The ن ش ر inventory itself includes dry herbage revived by rain, making a material analogy available before the focus crops arrive. Under that activation, vine-fruit and cut fodder are not static inventory: they are temporary visible phases in a larger cycle where concealment, apparent ending, water, emergence, harvest, and renewed provision coexist.

activation_trace.role: The vine-fruit image supplies a visible mature phase of life emerging into yield.
The fresh-cut fodder image supplies a harvested phase that looks terminal locally but remains provision within the cycle.
The loss-of-life image supplies the apparent endpoint from which the later cycle departs.
The burial image supplies concealment beneath ground as an intermediate rather than final state.
The revival image supplies the directional reversal from ending to renewed life.
The rain-revived dry-herbage image explicitly carries revival into the plant domain that contains the focus pair.

structural_cues: 80:21-80:22 orders death, burial, and renewed animation before 80:24 redirects attention to food.
80:25-80:28 then orders water, opened earth, emergence, and named crops, supporting a material analogy without identifying the two cycles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the human reversal, a branch of rain-revived herbage, and the subsequent crop process; I infer that the focus harvests make the earlier reversal materially imaginable and that cutting is a phase rather than absolute extinction. The alternative is simple juxtaposition, with no cross-domain analogy intended.

changed_reading.before: The focus nouns are finished products presented for consumption.
changed_reading.after: They become visible phases in a concealment-to-emergence cycle, with even cut fodder participating in renewed provision rather than signifying a final end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The instruction to inspect food opens a list later closed by a provision formula naming both people and cattle. Within that frame, the focus pair already contains a miniature spectrum: vine-fruit aligns with pleasurable fruit and direct tasting, while fresh-cut herbage aligns with pasture and livestock wealth. The alignment is functional, not an exclusive item-by-item allocation; the coordinated list keeps the whole system shared.

activation_trace.role: The edible vine-fruit image supplies the focus pair's direct-fruit pole.
The fresh green-fodder image supplies the focus pair's pasture and livestock-use pole.
The tasting-and-taking image frames the crop list as usable nourishment rather than detached scenery.
The pleasant-fruit image strengthens the direct human enjoyment side of the focus grape.
The pasture image strengthens the fodder side of the focus cutting-derived crop.
The enjoyable-benefit image turns the entire list into sustained use across recipients.
The livestock-wealth image supplies the explicitly nonhuman beneficiary class.

structural_cues: The focus pair sits inside one coordinated accusative crop list initiated in 80:27 and closed by the beneficiary phrase in 80:32.
The later fruit-and-pasture pairing in 80:31 recapitulates, at category level, the focus pair's fruit-and-fresh-fodder contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct eating, pleasant fruit, pasture, beneficial provision, and cattle alongside the focus branch images; I infer that the focus pair prototypes a recipient spectrum. A live alternative is that every listed crop belongs to undivided abundance and no local human-versus-animal alignment should be assigned.

changed_reading.before: The two crops add variety to a list intended generically as food.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a compact bridge across modes of nourishment and beneficiary classes: pleasurable fruit and cut fodder within one shared provision system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered actions of pouring, opening earth, and bringing forth seed-bearing growth convert the baseline attachment-and-cutting model into a process. The first rupture opens a medium so life can emerge; the later cut separates living growth at the point of use. The focus pair thus marks differentiated endpoints of one cultivation chain: maturation into vine-fruit and timely cutting into fresh fodder.

activation_trace.role: The mature vine-fruit image supplies one endpoint of the preceding cultivation process.
The cutting image supplies a second, human-timed rupture that converts growth into harvest.
The fresh-fodder image specifies why the second rupture is productive and time-sensitive.
The pouring image supplies directional water input to the cultivation chain.
The cracking-open image supplies a productive rupture that enables emergence rather than merely destroying a whole.
The plant-emerging-from-earth image connects the prior operations to the focus outputs.
The seed-that-grows-and-bears-seed image supplies regenerative continuity immediately before the focus pair.

structural_cues: 80:25-80:27 is an explicit causal sequence of input, opened medium, and emergence immediately before the focus.
Cognate accusatives intensify the actions in 80:25 and 80:26; the syntax then switches to coordinated accusative outputs in 80:27-80:31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pouring, productive opening, plant emergence, regenerative seed, vine-fruit, and cut fodder; I infer that harvest cutting is the terminal counterpart to earth opening and that the two focus nouns mark different timings of use. The alternative is that the cutting sense is fully lexicalized away in the fodder noun.

changed_reading.before: The focus pair names results after an unspecified growth process.
changed_reading.after: It forms the harvest hinge of the stated process: an enabling rupture below, emergence, then either maturation on the vine or a timely productive cut.

context_deltas.mechanism: The baseline swelling-versus-cut contrast acquires an ecological rather than merely somatic mechanism. Poured irrigation, water conveyed into growth, watery luster in fruit, and saturation to fullness allow the grape-like swelling branch to model water gathered beneath a skin; the adjacent cutting branch supplies opening and redistribution. The pair can be carried as two material fates of water in cultivation: concentrated in a rounded fruit and released through cut green matter.

activation_trace.role: The fluid-filled swelling image supplies the contained, skin-bounded geometry that context recasts ecologically.
The cutting image supplies the opposed operation of opening and separating hydrated growth.
The pouring image supplies the macroscopic flow that later becomes stored in plant matter.
The irrigation-and-conveyance image supplies movement of water into the cultivated system.
The water-like luster in fruit image supplies a direct bridge from irrigation to visible fruit fullness.
The saturation-to-fullness image supplies the transition from incoming water to filled organic matter.

structural_cues: The poured water of 80:25 is only three verses before the focus pair and causally governs the crop sequence.
The focus coordination places the bounded fruit immediately beside a noun with an active opening-and-separation inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water flow, irrigation, watery fruit-luster, saturation, swelling, and cutting; I infer a contained-water versus opened-hydration contrast. The swelling branch is pathological and form-distant, so the live alternative is that only ordinary grape juiciness, not the swelling image, should survive in prose.

changed_reading.before: Contained pressure and cutting form an isolated material contrast.
changed_reading.after: The contrast becomes hydraulic and ecological: poured water is gathered into bounded fruit while cut green matter represents an opened, redistributed form of the same provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene combines flight with a rapid inventory of the strongest human bonds. That sequence reactivates the focus pair's topology: fruit held in relation to a vine stands beside a root of cutting off and breaking away from place. The agricultural pair can therefore cast a distant material shadow of relation under pressure, preserving attachment and severance as coexisting possibilities rather than turning either crop into a fixed allegory.

activation_trace.role: The fruit-in-relation-to-vine image supplies sustained attachment to a living source.
The breaking-away-from-place image supplies abrupt detachment rather than ordinary pruning alone.
The flight image activates detachment as urgent human action.
The tether-and-bond image makes what flight severs structurally explicit.
The companionship-and-continuance image supplies durable proximity as the counterforce to flight.
The filiation-and-origin image extends attachment through descent and source.

structural_cues: 80:34-80:36 begins with flight and then coordinates brother, mother, father, companion, and children as successively named bonds.
The focus itself coordinates an attached vine product with a cutting-derived product, making a relation-versus-detachment geometry available before the social scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vine relation, breaking away, flight, tether, companionship, and descent; I infer a distant material prefiguration of social attachment under catastrophic pressure. The alternative is that the later kin sequence should not reactivate agricultural branch geometry at all.

changed_reading.before: Attachment and cutting describe only two agricultural handling states.
changed_reading.after: They also remain available as a contained structural echo of bonds held and bonds abruptly abandoned, without converting the crops into allegorical labels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus forms ordinarily name produce, not equipment. It remains anchored because one focus inventory contains a thick bowstring image and the other contains cut branch material for bows and arrows, yielding a complete tension-and-projectile complex from the two roots alone. Downstream prose should mark it as a branch-distant material flash, never as a replacement gloss or historical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The co-presence of the thick-string branch under focus word 1 and the bow-or-arrow bough branch under focus word 2.

activation_trace.role: The thick bowstring image supplies stored tension and one half of a projectile apparatus.
The cut bough used for bows or slender arrows supplies the apparatus's shaped wooden half.

changed_reading.before: The two roots meet only in the semantic field of plants.
changed_reading.after: At the far edge of their inventories they unexpectedly assemble a material system of string tension and shaped bough, a latent flash beneath the crop pair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because the extemporized-speech branch is form-distant from the focus crop noun and the focus syntax remains a literal produce list. It stays anchored in the focus ق ض ب inventory and is activated by earlier branches contrasting speech on the tongue with written sheets and a book that discloses writing. Render only as a possible meta-poetic flicker of fresh-cut, unprepared utterance inside a carefully mediated reminder, not as the noun's contextual denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The extemporized-speech branch of focus word 2, held beneath its fresh-cut plant sense.

activation_trace.role: The improvised-speech image supplies an utterance produced immediately, as if cut fresh rather than prepared.
The remembrance-running-on-the-tongue image supplies the oral register against which spontaneous speech can flicker.
The written-sheet image supplies a fixed textual counterpole to unprepared utterance.
The book-revealing-what-is-written image strengthens the mediated-writing side of the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The second focus noun contributes only a harvested plant item.
changed_reading.after: Its remote speech branch briefly makes the line sound freshly uttered within a context that has already foregrounded oral remembrance and written mediation.

strongest_changes: The focus pair changed from two crop labels into complementary harvest regimes: maturation on a vine and usefulness through a timely fresh cut.
The water-opening-emergence sequence turned attachment and severance into stages of one cultivation process rather than opposed static images.
The later fruit, pasture, provision, and cattle cues made the pair a compact bridge across modes of nourishment and beneficiary classes.
Earlier ك ر م and death-burial-revival branches opened two independent cross-domain readings: cultivated generosity and a material analogy of renewed life.
summary.what_was_special: The same two-word focus sustained several mechanisms without forced merger: fruit and fodder, attachment and harvest severance, contained water and opening, abstract honor returning as vine, life-cycle reversal, and a distant social topology of bonds. The bow apparatus and improvised-speech readings remain deliberately contained but alive.
remaining_uncertainties: The strongest ambiguity is whether the cutting force of ق ض ب remains audible in context or has receded behind a lexicalized fodder name.
The ك ر م-to-vine echo and the later bond-versus-flight model may be genuine latent organization or only available polysemy aligned by the reader.
The swelling, bowstring, and extemporized-speech branches are visibly anchored but too form-distant to enter unqualified downstream prose.
